WHAT: Pixel office-layout.ts furniture items use offsetY to position sprites above their tile position. Wall-mounted items need large negative offset.

WHERE: src/game/office-layout.ts

HOW:
- Paintings on wall: { type: 'painting', tx, ty, offsetY: -22 }
- Clock on wall: { type: 'clock', tx, ty, offsetY: -22, pngH: 32 } ← pngH is 32 NOT 16
- Double bookshelf: 32×32 sprite (covers 2 tiles tall)
- Bins were confusing (look like white pots) — removed
- Plants must stay ≥1 tile away from all walls (internal walls at row 7, outer walls at rows 0/13 and cols 0/19)

GOTCHA: clock.png is 16×32 — if you set pngH:16 it clips the top half and looks invisible. Always check actual PNG dimensions with `identify` or read the file.
